description.value: Blueridge Liquor Store is one of several locations operated by the locally owned Gian's Group in the Abbotsford area. The store carries a broad selection of local craft beers, wines, spirits, soft drinks, and snacks. It is a retail off-licence shop, not a café or restaurant.
